judged_text: The rewritten Disqus import drops the created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]) argument the previous implementation passed, so TopicEmbed.import_remote creates every imported topic with the current timestamp instead of the original thread date. Anyone running the disqus import after this change gets an archive whose topics are all dated at import time; the chronological ordering of the imported discussions is destroyed and cannot be recovered without re-running the import against the original Disqus export.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the old implementation created the first post/topic with `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])`. The new code replaces this with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` / `TopicEmbed.import` do not accept or pass through any `created_at` value to `PostCreator` (they only pass `title`, `raw`, `skip_validations`, `cook_method`). Therefore imported topics/posts will use the current timestamp rather than the original Disqus thread date, affecting chronological ordering.
